integrations.name: Cloudflare Worker edge runtime
integrations.nextAction: Verify deployed commit provenance and /health response against the expected SHA.
integrations.risk: A repository binding does not prove the deployed runtime uses it.

integrations.name: Python Core HTTPS execution
integrations.nextAction: Run the strict authenticated hybrid probe against the current live deployment; require HTTP 200, engine=python-edge-hybrid, fallbackEngaged=false, and hybridPythonCoreExecutionVerified=true. Current live deployment identity alone does not prove authenticated execution.
integrations.risk: Health-only checks can pass while authenticated execution fails.

integrations.name: Worker-to-Python owner-secret authentication
integrations.nextAction: Use authorized secret metadata/comparison APIs to verify length and parity without returning values; then separately approve any required secret sync and re-run authenticated execution.
integrations.risk: Never disclose, log, or place secret values in repository files.

integrations.name: Cloudflare D1 owner-auth database
integrations.nextAction: Check migration history and schema with non-destructive read-only probes.
integrations.risk: Binding configuration does not prove migrations or runtime queries work.

integrations.name: Cloudflare KV sessions
integrations.nextAction: Verify the binding and bounded session read/write behavior using disposable test keys.
integrations.risk: Do not inspect or expose live session values.

integrations.name: Sentinel Pulse Durable Object
integrations.nextAction: Confirm the exported class, migration implementation, and live pulse route.
integrations.risk: A binding and migration tag alone are insufficient runtime evidence.

integrations.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
integrations.nextAction: Trace actual model call sites and run a bounded non-sensitive smoke test.
integrations.risk: Avoid assuming model execution from the presence of an AI binding.

integrations.name: Live search and fallback routing
integrations.nextAction: Verify returned source URLs, timeout, fallback behavior, and stale-cache indicators with live queries.
integrations.risk: A syntactically valid response is not proof of fresh or correctly sourced results.

integrations.name: Logs, traces, and redaction
integrations.nextAction: Test redaction using synthetic secrets and verify headers, request bodies, and query strings are not leaked.
integrations.risk: Observability must not record credentials or sensitive payloads.

integrations.name: Installable app shell and service worker
integrations.nextAction: Verify deployed asset cache version, update activation, and offline navigation on Android Chrome.
integrations.risk: Merged code does not prove production asset freshness or offline behavior.

integrations.name: CI and production deployment controls
integrations.nextAction: PR #431 contains manual-only production gates on its draft branch, but main remains unchanged until review/merge. Verify required reviewers and branch protection before production mutation.
integrations.risk: Push-triggered workflows can mutate production without an explicit per-run approval.

integrations.name: Registered agent catalog and runtime dispatch
integrations.nextAction: Keep the eight bounded runtime roles owner-session gated and side-effect-free; provision catalog-only roles through a reviewed pilot with per-agent health, audit, timeout, cancellation and approval checks before expanding.
integrations.risk: The catalog lists 90 specifications (0 provisioned, automatic dispatch disabled); the Central Agent separately defines eight bounded runtime roles. Do not conflate either count with 90 running agents.

integrations.name: Banking and financial integrations
integrations.nextAction: Define provider, read-only data scope, consent, and sandbox contract before building an adapter.
integrations.risk: No real transfers, payments, or account mutations; sandbox/read-only by default.

integrations.name: Bunker project integration
integrations.nextAction: Discover the authoritative repository or API contract before asserting integration status.
integrations.risk: Do not guess endpoints, credentials, or repository identity.
